task_completion.description: Open the 'Mitosis (5D stack)' sample image in Fiji.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Fiji window showing an image titled 'mitosis' or 'Mitosis (5D stack)' with dimensions 171x196, 2 channels, 5 slices, and 51 frames.

task_completion.description: Generate a Maximum Intensity Z-Projection for the time series.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A new image window titled 'MAX_mitosis' or similar, showing a flattened version of the stack where mitotic spindles/chromosomes are bright.

task_completion.description: Apply thresholding to the projected image to isolate mitotic objects.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The image or a duplicate showing a red overlay (mask) or a binary (black and white) representation of the cells/nuclei.

task_completion.description: Run 'Analyze Particles' or a similar measurement tool on all time frames.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Results' table window in Fiji populated with multiple rows (ideally 51) containing 'Area' and 'Count' data.

task_completion.description: Save the analysis results to the specified CSV path.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A file explorer window or terminal command showing the existence of '~/ImageJ_Data/results/mitosis_timeseries.csv' or a 'Save As' dialog pointing to that path.

integrity.description: The agent used the Fiji GUI to perform the analysis rather than just writing a script or using terminal commands.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots showing the Fiji menu being navigated (e.g., Image > Stacks > Z Project) and dialog boxes for Threshold or Analyze Particles.

integrity.description: The agent did not manually type the CSV content or copy-paste it from a hidden source.
integrity.visual_evidence: The Results table in Fiji matches the values being saved to the CSV; the number of rows corresponds to the 51 time frames.

integrity.description: The agent used the specific 'Mitosis (5D stack)' sample provided in Fiji.
integrity.visual_evidence: The image metadata in the Fiji status bar shows 51 frames and 5 Z-slices.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The 'Mitosis (5D stack)' sample in Fiji has exactly 51 time frames and 5 Z-slices. The image dimensions are 171x196 pixels with 2 channels. Channel 2 typically highlights the chromosomes/mitotic events better for thresholding. The final CSV must contain 51 rows of data (one for each time point) and be saved specifically to ~/ImageJ_Data/results/mitosis_timeseries.csv.
